title: StandingId
wikitext: These numeric values are used to indicate how a player is perceived by a specific faction. == Values == ; 0 - Unknown ; 1 - Hated ; 2 - Hostile ; 3 - Unfriendly ; 4 - Neutral ; 5 - Friendly ; 6 - Honored ; 7 - Revered ; 8 - Exalted These values are defined globaly by the FACTION_STANDING_LABEL(x) variables. Probably locale specific. It's better to use them instead of relying on the hardcoded values above. == Example == /script x=4; temp=getglobal("FACTION_STANDING_LABEL".x); message(temp); Gives the message "Neutral". == Notes == The API page from which this was moved credits Saien with providing the first documentation on these numbers.
